iatanote: Jet marjı, ABD Körfez Kıyısı jet yakıtı spot fiyatı × 42 − Brent spot fiyatı olarak hesaplanır. IATA yalnızca dış kaynak bağlantısıdır.

providers.iata: IATA / Platts Jet Fuel Price Monitor
providers._doc: EIA is primary when EIA_API_KEY is set; otherwise FRED serves the same EIA spot series. Yahoo BZ=F futures are stored separately from Brent spot. IATA is an external reference link only and is never ingested.

market._doc: ECB rates are still collected and stored; with display_fx false the API serves no fx_usd_* items or fx events. Values are CURRENCY per 1 USD (USD/EUR 0.889 means 1 USD = 0.889 EUR).
